Title : Head of Game Security
Department : Game Security
Location : Remote
About CoinPoker

Welcome to CoinPoker , the innovative crypto-poker platform where advanced blockchain technology meets the thrilling world of online poker. At CoinPoker , we are revolutionizing the poker experience by offering fast, secure, and transparent gameplay. With recent substantial investment, we are poised to take over the online crypto-poker space and are expanding our team to support our growth.

CoinPoker is hiring a Head of Game Security to protect game integrity on its crypto poker platform. You will be the single point of contact for every game and general security tech requirement. Security tech roadmap (SPOC)

• Act as the single intake point for all game and general security tech requirements going to Product and Tech.

Game Security team

• Manage and develop the game analyst team.

Threat intelligence

• Track fraud trends in online poker and crypto gambling, and brief leadership every month.

• 5+ years in game integrity, fraud, or trust and safety, with at least 2 years leading a team.

• Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.
